steps.eval: (async () => { const link = document.querySelector('link[rel=manifest]'); const manifest = await (await fetch(link.href, { credentials: 'omit' })).json(); if ((manifest.display !== 'standalone') || (new URL(manifest.start_url, link.href).href !== new URL('./', location.href).href)) throw new Error('unexpected manifest'); const icons = [...manifest.icons.map((icon) => new URL(icon.src, link.href).href), document.querySelector('link[rel=apple-touch-icon]').href]; const statuses = await Promise.all(icons.map(async (src) => (await fetch(src, { credentials: 'omit' })).status)); if (statuses.some((status) => status !== 200)) throw new Error(`icons: ${statuses}`); return [manifest.name, manifest.display, statuses]; })()

(() => { const toRgb = (color) => { const div = document.createElement('div'); div.style.color = color; document.body.append(div); const rgb = getComputedStyle(div).color; div.remove(); return rgb; }; let top = document.elementFromPoint(innerWidth - 2, 2); while (getComputedStyle(top).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') top = top.parentElement; const header = getComputedStyle(top).backgroundColor; const colors = [...document.querySelectorAll('meta[name=theme-color]')].map((meta) => toRgb(meta.content)); if (colors.some((color) => color !== header)) throw new Error(`theme-color ${colors} vs. ${header} of ${top.id}`); return [top.id, header]; })()
